purpose: Audit archive, ZIP, docs, and review-needed assets without extracting, deleting, moving, or converting files.

summary.recommended_next_step: Run a deeper file-tree inventory for ZIP contents and orphaned /sites paths before extraction.

archive_entries.title: Flash UI ZIP Archives
archive_entries.risk_notes: ZIP files may contain duplicate exports, nested build systems, malformed paths, junk files, or generated app code. Do not extract directly into production paths until contents are inventoried.
archive_entries.next_batch_instruction: List ZIP filenames, sizes, root folders, whether each contains index.html, package.json, markdown files, or nested archives. Then decide extract, archive-only, standalone app, or duplicate-ignore.

archive_entries.title: Fash UI Templates Notion
archive_entries.risk_notes: Notion exports may include duplicate markdown pages, generated assets, and internal naming that is not production-friendly.
archive_entries.next_batch_instruction: Create a docs index page only after confirming markdown filenames and whether they duplicate registry assets.

archive_entries.title: sites Fash UI Templates Notion
archive_entries.risk_notes: Likely duplicate or near-duplicate of the root Notion export. Preserve until confirmed.
archive_entries.next_batch_instruction: Compare file names and checksums against the root docs archive before converting or removing in a later approval-gated cleanup batch.

nested_app_entries.title: Financing Widget

normalization_policy.root_html_policy: Preserve root files until intentionally copied or moved in a cleanup batch.
normalization_policy.zip_policy: Do not extract ZIPs in bulk. Inventory first, extract only selected winners later.
normalization_policy.docs_policy: Do not convert Notion/Markdown exports until duplicate paths and content value are reviewed.
